title: Network Self-Healing Remediation Agent

blueprintSignals.name: Correlated incident severity
blueprintSignals.definition: number of impacted subscribers and services behind the alarm group
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Computed from topology at alarm time

blueprintSignals.name: Runbook match score
blueprintSignals.definition: similarity of incident symptoms to the symptoms recorded in each approved runbook
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Runbooks must be versioned with the topology they were written for

blueprintSignals.name: Blast radius estimate
blueprintSignals.definition: count of cells and customers reachable from the target element
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Use the live inventory not a stale snapshot

blueprintSignals.name: Recent change proximity
blueprintSignals.definition: changes applied to the element or neighbours in the last 24 hours
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Change records must be timestamped when applied not when approved

label: For "Network Self-Healing Remediation Agent": Detect a customer-impacting network fault, match it to an approved runbook, propose or apply a fix through the orchestrator and verify recovery, so time to restore falls without unsafe changes reaching the live network. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Letting the model compose raw commands.
